purpose: Private editorial operations linked to the existing Knowledge Centre and evidence-controlled clinical governance. No website layout changes.
dueDateMeaning: Internal deadline for a complete content draft, not a publication claim.
plannedPublicationDateMeaning: Desired date for a future release; not an actual publication claim.
publicationDateMeaning: Actual date when site deployment was confirmed, after clinical/practice approval and technical QA.
nextReviewDateMeaning: Specific approved future review date. Must follow approval and live publication; review sooner on guidance changes.
clinicalApprovalRule: Clinical status approved requires reviewer name/date/reference, practice approver name/date/reference, evidence reference and matching page-content SHA256. Metadata alone cannot authenticate signatures; supporting evidence must be retained securely offline.
publishingGate: reviewedContentSha256 matches current main content; obtain via build_clinical_governance.py --fingerprint
clinical reviewer and practice approver signed off in the correct order
source, SEO, accessibility and internal links verified
nextReviewDate is later than published date
website deployed and verified by a named operator before recording actual publicationDate
existingGovernance: For any new article added to live site, also register governance eligibility and follow cms/tools/build_clinical_governance.py approval process before showing patient-facing reviewed-by metadata.
privacy: Admin dashboard and completed export must never be served publicly or committed with personal approval evidence.
constraints: No publication from a content calendar record alone
Published pages cannot be silently modified without renewal of evidence
No changes to patient-facing design or approved brand voice
